decision: The existing assignee slot has a reachable height transition between its unchanged editable/read-only branches. Matching its minimum to the existing select h-8 is a minimal presentation correction with the original authority and strict physical-input oracle preserved. This is prospective approval only, not source or E2E PASS.
reasoning: min-h-8 uses the same spacing token as the existing small select h-8. It reserves the existing editable height without a fixed dialog height or new wrapper.
At the recorded single-row width, the assigned badge size-6 versus select h-8 difference is consistent with the exact 8 px dialog contraction and 4 px movement of the centered absolute Close target.

The original final check correctly refused before mousePressed. The proposed source fix leaves the complete helper, visibility/hit testing, current renderer ownership, two stable observations, final equality and click count/order unchanged.
Authority transitions remain legitimate. The fix neither preserves stale ownership nor stops reads or changes canReassign, onOwnerChange, canEditNow, deletion/readiness/surface/context checks.
The minimum allows larger/wrapped content to grow. It addresses this reachable assignee-height transition; it does not guarantee every possible responsive reflow or all dialog geometry is stationary.
precisionLimits: The historical snapshot is not atomic with the failed guarded read. The exact owner/read-phase transition that caused that original move remains unproven.
The 8 px delta is the observed assigned-badge/small-select comparison. Do not promote it to a universal upper bound on added space for every unassigned-only or wrapped header.
The archived later screenshot is byte-bound here; no new screenshot or GUI execution was performed. This review independently checks retained geometry and source, not a recreated historical render.
Original INCOMPLETE status and unreached Task Board actions remain. Empty app process-group cleanup is not a separately observed captured Host absence.
futureSourceReviewObligations: Exactly one min-h-8 token in the existing assignee slot; all condition/handler/child bytes stay unchanged.
Exactly one Header path appended after the landed CDP common operand;256 old common paths remain ordered prefix, count257;27 process and46 Windows Retry arrays remain byte-identical.
Reverse those two selected insertions to restore both entire beforeimages; verify actual fresh parent leaves and preserve all incoming work.
